_purpose: The whole text of the collection: the quotation corpus and its indexes, every numbered folder of the library, guide/, the journal and its issue file, the root documents, and kb/LIBRARY_SETUP.md (the library's shelves, reading lists, folders, books and journal contents, written by the site build from site-src/). Sourced from the folders at `ref`; nothing is copied into kb/. The sync takes text files only (the CLI's processable extensions); PDF, DOCX, HTML, images and audio stay on the site and in the repository, and each source's syncignore names the ones it holds, with code and build files. publish_tier P: the CLI runs its deny lint before any walk and fails the sync on a hit; every source carries a doc_class (proposed here; the author decides). Every primary-source carries the license basis stated in Copyright_Fair-use_Memo.md.
